```sql
WITH overlapping_departments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h1.department_id
    FROM head h1
    JOIN head h2 ON h1.department_id = h2.department_id AND h1.id <> h2.id
    WHERE h1.start_date <= h2.end_date AND h1.end_date >= h2.start_date
)
SELECT d.id, d.name, COUNT(h.id) AS num_heads
FROM department d
JOIN head h ON d.id = h.department_id
WHERE d.id IN (SELECT department_id FROM overlapping_departments)
GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
```
